title: JCP_Patient_53_SLIT_pre_expression
treatment_protocol_ch1: PBMC samples from seven out-patients suffering from JCP, which were obtained both before and at one-year after initiating SLIT administration. PBMCs were purified from whole blood using the Ficoll-Hypaque technique and cultured as previously described16. RPMI 1640 (Sigma-Aldrich), supplemented with fetal calf serum (10%), L-glutamine (2 μM), penicillin (100 U/ml), streptomycin (100 μg/ml), HEPES (10 mM), 2-mercaptoethanol (55 μM), nonessential amino acids (1%), and sodium pyruvate (1 mM) (all from Gibco BRL, Grand Island, NY), was used as the culture medium. PBMCs obtained from patients were pre-cultured (1 × 106 cells/ml) at 37°C overnight and cells were stimulated with Sugi (Japanese cedar in Japanese) basic protein (SBP; 2 µg/ml; HAYASHIBARA, Okayama, Japan) in the presence of rhIL-2 (1 U/ml; Kyowa, Tokyo, Japan) for 5 days. SBP is composed of major Japanese cedar pollen allergen Cry j 1 and Cry j 2.
extract_protocol_ch1: Cultured PBMCs were immediately processed in TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA). For comparison of good responder and poor responders, 25 ng/ml of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate and 1 µg/ml of ionomycin (Sigma-Aldrich) were added at the last 4 h of culture because the number of cells available was small.
Singel cell RNA-seq, Single cell TCR V(D)J segments (scVDJ-seq)
Libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 5’ Reagent Kits v1.1 and Single-Cell V(D)J Enrichment Kit for Human T Cells according to manufacturer’s protocol (10X Genomics).
data_processing: Basecalls and mapping performed using Cell Ranger ver 6.0
Supplementary files format and content: TCR VDJ, barcodes, features and matrix tsv files

metadata.source_identity_policy: Original patient/pre-post title, source patient/treat fields and exact RNA asset names agree. Seven source people have paired visits. Extra46post capture is conservatively dependent on the same patient/post material; no separate draw inferred from expression-2 label.
metadata.source_handling_policy: Source methods explicitly describe PBMC culture and stimulation before RNA collection. These are conditional experimental views from clinical PBMC draws, not untouched in-vivo PBMC composition or geometry.
metadata.source_time_policy: Source series reports before versus one year after initiating SLIT. Preserve pre/post and nominal study timing; exact calendar draw dates and individual elapsed durations not independently joined.
metadata.source_outcome_policy: Source high/low curative effect is treatment-response metadata, including on pre-treatment rows; it is not a baseline predictor or validated molecular state.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Per-source sex retained literally and lower-case normalized separately. Age and other clinical fields not independently joined; no cohort average assigned.
metadata.source_modality_policy: Gene Expression triplets only. Source VDJ assays are excluded; no receptor sequences acquired. Original native RNA genes define library denominators, with common project QC applied independently.
metadata.source_duplicate_scope_policy: Full original count values and all cross-capture profiles were reviewed. One exact reused ambient profile is below the unchanged500RNA-count gate and is excluded in both sources before conversion. No RNA-eligible profile reuse. Generic original-count guard is unchanged; this explicit cohort audit verifies the cells used by the existing QC.
metadata.source_alias_policy: Study-scoped patient codes; global cross-study participant/material identity unresolved.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; keep paired visits and all captures of each patient together

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells
